facts.label: Home protection
facts.text: Farmers describes coverage for repairing or rebuilding a home and replacing belongings after covered events, along with liability protection.

facts.label: Flood and earthquake
facts.text: The property overview says flood insurance is not included in home policies and earthquake coverage is typically separate.

facts.label: Different property types
facts.text: Farmers lists separate condo, landlord, mobile-home and specialty-home products. A standard homeowners policy should not be assumed to fit a rental, vacant or seasonal property.
